title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in 'under three hours' | TechCrunch
summary: In its latest flash cybersecurity advisory , the FBI says hackers have targeted several industries in recent months, including financial services, government, tech, defense, phone and internet companies, and law firms, using open source tools like Artex to carry out autonomous-driven cyberattacks.
